name: singlet_markers_de_replicate_aware_condition_de
title: Replicate-aware condition DE within a cell type
description: Tests which genes change between conditions within each annotated cell type, with donors or samples as the unit of inference: cells are summed to donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk and a donor-level model (default edgeR_QL) writes per-gene log2 fold change, statistic, p-value and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR to uns/de_replicate. Needs raw counts in layers/counts, keys.donor, a condition column and at least two donors per condition in each tested cell type; call with dry_run true first for time and memory. Do not use it when a condition has a single donor, for cluster markers without a condition (use markers-de.cluster_marker_ranking), or for conclusions from wilcoxon_naive, which treats cells as independent. random_split_null is a calibration check, not a DE result.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed; fixes the donor partitions in random_split_null mode. Condition DE is deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing uns/de_replicate and models members for the same cell types instead of failing.

method.description: Test method. DESeq2 runs the PyDESeq2 port (Wald test); wilcoxon_naive ignores donors and is a negative control only.

mode.description: condition_de tests the real contrast. random_split_null reassigns conditions among donors to measure calibration; needs one true condition.

keys.description: Names of the obs columns and the counts layer.

donor.description: obs column identifying the donor or sample; the unit of inference.

cell_type.description: obs column with cell-type labels; each cell type is tested separately.

condition.description: obs column with the condition; constant within donor for a between-donor design.

formula.description: Model formula over obs columns; must contain the condition term. Empty means ~ condition.

contrast.description: Coefficient or contrast to test. Empty tests the second condition level against the first.

paired_donor_block.description: Add the donor as a blocking term when the condition varies within donor; ignored with a warning when constant within donor.

cell_types.description: Cell types to test; empty means all.

min_cells_per_donor.description: A donor enters a cell type only with at least this many cells of that type.

min_donors_per_group.description: Minimum donors per condition for a cell type to be tested; a warning is issued below 4.

libsize_outlier_nmads.description: Drop donors whose log library size is a lower-tail outlier beyond this many MADs; 0 disables.

gene_filter.description: dreamlet: min.count 5, min.prop 0.4, min.samples 4. filterByExpr: edgeR rule, applied only when the maximum count exceeds 100.

testing.description: Multiple testing, shrinkage and calibration options.

fdr_scope.description: Apply Benjamini-Hochberg within each cell type or across all tested cell types.

alpha.description: Significance level for calls and calibration summaries.

robust_ebayes.description: Robust empirical Bayes shrinkage; edgeR_QL, limma_voom and limma_trend only.

lfc_threshold.description: Test against this minimum absolute log2 fold change (TREAT-style); 0 tests against zero. edgeR_QL and limma only.

n_partitions_null.description: Random donor partitions drawn in random_split_null mode.

cutoff_cell.description: Refit a gene with the HL likelihood when cells per subject times cell-level overdispersion falls below this value.

cpc.description: Genes with counts per cell below this value are not analysed.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/de_replicate/<cell_type>/results. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact per-run summary: method, mode, design, paired_donor_block_applied, n_cell_types_tested, per cell type donors per condition, genes tested and genes at alpha, skipped cell types with reasons, warnings; in random_split_null mode also type I error and lambda_GC per cell type. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
